title: EMT conduit, 1 in trade size, 10 ft stick

sources.citation: game-design: unverified (recalled, not read in this PR). The outside diameter (1.163 in = 29.54 mm) and nominal wall (0.057 in = 1.45 mm) of 1 trade size electrical metallic tubing as commonly published by makers for ANSI C80.3 / UL 797 EMT (cited by number only; no NEC Chapter 9 table is used). electrical-realism-reviewer to check against a manufacturer dimension sheet, then relabel real-world. The body box rounds the diameter up to 30 mm (even, so the ends sit on whole millimetres).

game-design: unverified. EMT is sold in 10 ft (3048 mm) sticks (common practice); sizeMm is the uncut stick along +x and the body diameter (30 mm). Cut ends are taken as square and reamed (no burr modelled).
game-design: a new stick is cut to 1000 mm; raceway.cut makes pieces from 50 mm to the full stick.
